meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页打磨得更美观、更规范,同时兼顾性能与无障碍。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常做前端界面调整,却不太确定设计是否好看。
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages to be more elegant, consistent, and accessible.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweak frontend interfaces but are unsure about design taste.

howto.what: 处理网页或界面设计时,Claude 会先写设计规范(DESIGN.md)再实现;涉及性能时用真实浏览器审计,目标是各项满分;还能查配色字体、做无障碍检查与设计评审。
howto.when: 只要是网页或界面方面的构建、样式或重设计工作都会被触发;说出“设计”“前端”“React”等关键词,或要求做性能、无障碍审计时也会进入。

say.text: 帮我设计这个网页,先写 DESIGN.md 再实现。
say.note: Claude 会先产出设计规范,再按它写代码。

say.text: 把这个旧界面重设计一下,风格参考 Linear。
say.note: 会先分析现有界面,再提取风格做改版。

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 给这个前端页面做个性能审计。
say.note: 会启动真实浏览器跑审计并汇报结果。

howto.what_en: For web or UI work, Claude first writes a DESIGN.md contract, builds to it, and audits performance with Playwright/Lighthouse (target 100 everywhere). It also looks up palettes/fonts and does accessibility checks and design critique.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any frontend/interface building, styling, or redesign work, and when you mention keywords like 'design', 'frontend', 'React', or ask for performance or accessibility audits.

say_en.text: Design this page for me — write a DESIGN.md first, then build it.
say_en.note: Writes the spec first, then implements.

say_en.text: Redesign this old UI following Linear's style.
say_en.note: Analyzes the current UI, extracts the style, rebuilds it.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse performance audit on this frontend page.
say_en.note: Runs a real-browser audit and reports the results.
